_about: The VAWA self-petition packet (src/vawa.py): the G-28 and the I-360 (VAWA map), then the client's declaration, then the evidence in the order of the Form I-360 Instructions (01/20/25, pages 6-7: 1 the abuser's status, 2 the legal relationship, 3 living together, 4 the abuse, 5 good moral character, 6 a spouse's good faith marriage), then identity and entry. Any credible evidence counts (INA 204(a)(1)(J)): only the declaration is required here. Variants: 'concurrent' adds the I-485 in the same envelope (an abusive U.S. citizen: always possible; a permanent resident: when a visa is available); 'i485_only' is the I-485 on an I-360 already filed (uscis.gov 'Green Card for VAWA Self-Petitioner', updated 06/26/2026). DRAFT: the attorney approves titles and order.
title: VAWA self-petition (I-360)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: Every notice goes to the safe address on the I-360 (Part 1, 7) and the G-28: check it before printing. The abuser's address appears only where the form asks for the last address shared (Part 10, 10).
The client's declaration, signed: the relationship, living together, the abuse, good faith (a spouse) and good moral character (14 or older: Form I-360 Instructions, page 7).

14 or older: a police clearance or state criminal background check from each place the client lived 6 months or more in the 3 years before filing, in the U.S. or abroad (Form I-360 Instructions, page 7).

exhibits.title: The self-petitioner's declaration (personal statement) and statements of others who know the facts
The abuser's U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residence
The legal relationship to the abuser: marriage certificate, divorce decrees, birth certificates (with certified English translations)
Living together: leases, utility bills, school, medical or employment records
The abuse: police and court records, protection orders, medical records, statements of shelters, social workers, clergy or school officials, photographs
Good moral character: police clearances or state criminal background checks
Good faith marriage (a spouse): joint tax returns, bank accounts, insurance, leases
Identity and entry: passport, U.S. visa, Form I-94, photo identification, work permit
Immigration court documents (Notice to Appear, orders)

leave_out.intake_questionnaire: The firm's own intake questionnaire: internal.
leave_out.i360_approval: An I-360 approval is in the folder: the packet becomes the I-485 on it once the approval notice is read. Ask the attorney.
leave_out.sij_order: A Special Immigrant Juvenile court order: not part of a VAWA petition. Ask the attorney.
leave_out.ssn_card: Not asked for with the I-360.
leave_out.pay_stub: Not asked for with the I-360: put it in the good faith exhibit only if it shows the couple's shared life.
leave_out.w2: Not asked for with the I-360: put it in the good faith exhibit only if it shows the couple's shared life.

i485_vawa.title: Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status (VAWA self-petitioner)

handwork.text: Every notice goes to the safe address on the I-360 (Part 1, 7), the I-485 (Part 1, 18) and the G-28: check it before printing. The abuser's address appears only where the form asks for the last address shared (Part 10, 10).
The client's declaration, signed: the relationship, living together, the abuse, good faith (a spouse) and good moral character (14 or older: Form I-360 Instructions, page 7).

14 or older: a police clearance or state criminal background check from each place the client lived 6 months or more in the 3 years before filing, in the U.S. or abroad (Form I-360 Instructions, page 7).
Two identical passport-style photos for the I-485; the client's name and A-Number lightly in pencil on the back.
Form I-693 (medical exam) in the civil surgeon's sealed envelope, with the I-485 (uscis.gov, Green Card for VAWA Self-Petitioner).

i485_vawa.title: Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status (VAWA self-petitioner)

handwork.text: Every notice goes to the safe address on the I-485 (Part 1, 18) and the G-28: check it before printing.
Two identical passport-style photos; the client's name and A-Number lightly in pencil on the back.
Form I-693 (medical exam) in the civil surgeon's sealed envelope (uscis.gov, Green Card for VAWA Self-Petitioner).

exhibits.title: The I-360's receipt or approval notice (Form I-797)
Birth certificate, with certified English translation
Identity and entry: passport, U.S. visa, Form I-94, photo identification, work permit
Certified police and court records of any arrest, charge or conviction
Immigration court documents (Notice to Appear, orders)
